_doc: Hospital zone and university campus (claude/fill-high-street, 19 Nov): which business or service is behind which

rooms.label: hospital
rooms.name: Island Hospital Main Lobby
rooms.why: the hospital's front door on the drop-off forecourt: reception and admissions desks, waiting seats, the way to the wards

rooms.label: hospital
rooms.name: Atrium Cafe
rooms.why: the hospital's second front door: coffee and sandwiches for visitors and the night shift, next to the lobby

rooms.label: er_wing
rooms.name: Emergency Department
rooms.why: the ER's front door on the ambulance bay (EMERGENCY painted over it): triage desk, the waiting room

rooms.label: transit_hall
rooms.name: Island Transit Center
rooms.why: Yasin: 'Place a bus station at hospital': the waiting hall on the bus platform: ticket windows, timetables, benches, vending

rooms.label: tower
rooms.name: Bay Medical Plaza Urgent Care
rooms.why: the medical office tower's door on Adela, facing the hospital: the walk-in clinic for what is not an emergency

rooms.label: pharmacy
rooms.name: Island Pharmacy
rooms.why: prescriptions for the people leaving the hospital and the clinic, on 3rd St between the tower and the bus station

rooms.label: bistro
rooms.name: Isla Bistro
rooms.why: lunch for the hospital's staff and visitors (its ISLA BISTRO sign painted on); its tables on the 3rd St forecourt

rooms.label: wellness
rooms.name: Bayview Wellness Center
rooms.why: the care residences' day center (its COMMUNITY CENTER sign painted on): classes, meals, visitors; door on Adela for the bus riders
